correctness.rationale: All six coefficient columns (1,a),(1,b),(1,c),(1,1),(1,0),(0,1) are pairwise nonproportional for the stated a,b,c. Thus a common point has ≥3 nonzero coordinates and the two gradient rows have rank two, so (3,3) X is smooth and Calabi–Yau. Projective g-fixed eigenspaces intersect X only at C=(3,3) in P³; the other eigenspace contributes none since a≠b. Adjunction gives genus 10 and χ(C)=−18. The normal bundle N_{C/X}=O_C(1)⊕O_C(1) carries scalar ω, producing 1/3(1,1) transverse quotient, smooth blowup quotient Z with E=C×P¹ and discrepancy −1/3; age 2/3 makes quotient klt noncanonical. The holomorphic (3,0) form has eigencharacter ω² so K_Y is 3-torsion of exact index three, with q(Y)=0. Independent expansion of (1+H)^6/(1+3H)^2 gives c3=−16H³, χ(X)=−144, b3=148; Lefschetz fixed-curve number −18 makes tr(g|H³)=22 and invariant b3=64. No invariant holomorphic top form implies invariant h21=32; blowup adds genus10 to h21 and one h11 to yield h11=2,h21=42,h30=0. Burnside gives χ(Y)=−60 and χ(Z)=−78, agreeing with Hodge numbers. These analytic geometry steps are proven in RESULT.md, not by the packaged arithmetic verifier.
